news.headline: NWS Melbourne Mon Nov 23, 2:25 AM: River Flood Warnings remain in effect for the St. Johns River at Cocoa, Geneva, Astor, DeLand and Sanford — all five points are in Major Flood Stage or forecast to reach it in coming days, with prolonged flooding expected and additional rises possible from mid-week rain; near Cocoa the river was at 18.7 feet Sun 8:15 PM, above its previous record, and Melbourne is cloudy Mon morning at 65°F at 7 AM, high 71°F, rain chances 1-2% through the afternoon

Construction underway on 1000 Boulevard of the Arts in downtown Sarasota — Kolter Urban's 20-story waterfront tower will bring 117 luxury condominium residences alongside the Hyatt Centric Harborside hotel replacing the demolished Hyatt Regency; Fort Lauderdale-based Moss is general contractor, residences start at $1.5 million, completion slated for 2028

25-story tower planned under the Live Local Act at 215 5th Street in West Palm Beach — designed by Arquitectonica for PF Fund WPB, the mixed-use building would contain 91 residences, including 39 condominiums and 52 rental apartments, plus ground-floor retail

Florida's 9th-edition building code takes effect Dec 31, 2026 — the edition in effect on the permit application date governs the work for the life of the permit; the 2026 codes are based on the 2024 International Codes and include the 2023 National Electrical Code, and Miami-Dade portal submissions after 4 PM Dec 30 will be subject to the 2026 edition

Copper rebounds Mon Nov 23 after plunging more than 9% last week — the selloff was triggered by concerns over slowing AI infrastructure and data-center spending, which has driven copper demand for power distribution and cooling; Monday's modest recovery suggests some traders viewed the drop as overdone, with demand from renewables, EVs and traditional data centers still supporting prices

Midterm results could accelerate state push for A3 refrigerants — ACHR News: ACCA, PHCC and HARDI warn differing state rules could push ultra-low-GWP A3 refrigerants such as R-290 (propane) before contractors have adjusted to the A2L transition, and urge contractors to monitor state legislation and comment early on proposed refrigerant and code changes

Mortgage rates Mon Nov 23 — Bankrate's 30-year fixed national average is 7.41% today; Freddie Mac's weekly average was 7.28% on Nov 19, Mortgage News Daily's daily average was 7.33% on Fri Nov 20 after the stock selloff pushed bond yields down, and CME FedWatch on Friday put a 91.4% chance on a 25-basis-point Fed hike at the Dec 8-9 meeting; PCE inflation report is due Nov 25
news.source: Bankrate / Freddie Mac / Mortgage News Daily

news.headline: Markets in correction heading into Thanksgiving week — on Fri Nov 20 the S&P 500 fell 3.7% to 6,910.39, the Nasdaq fell 5.28% to 22,617.73 and the Dow fell 1.93% to 48,147.33; for the week the S&P 500 lost 8.6%, its worst week in more than 18 months, as the AI trade unwound; U.S. markets close Thu Nov 26 for Thanksgiving

NBA Sun Nov 22 — Miami Heat (10-6) beat the Oklahoma City Thunder 123-113 at Kaseya Center, Bam Adebayo posting a triple-double with 24 points, 15 rebounds and 12 assists for Miami's seventh straight win; Orlando Magic (7-9) lost at the Washington Wizards 116-96, Kyshawn George scoring 24 for Washington

NFL Week 11 Sun Nov 22 — all three Florida teams lost: Detroit Lions beat the Tampa Bay Buccaneers (3-7) 31-21, Buffalo Bills beat the Miami Dolphins (1-9) 26-9, and New York Giants upset the Jacksonville Jaguars (7-3) 23-18; Jahmyr Gibbs ran for 98 yards and two touchdowns for Detroit, Josh Allen passed for 304 yards for Buffalo, and Trevor Lawrence passed for 301 yards for Jacksonville
